📦 **Blocksail `293de4694`** — Add 26-connected Minimax connectivity pass to tools/townrise.py and bump Blockside

Refs TASK-1350

- tools/townrise.py: add _connect(g, bo, h) implementing the same
  26-connected FIFO Dial Minimax propagation (ground/deck/col_min seeds,
  radius 2..6 island bridge, >= 248 fallback for remote ungrounded props) at
  the end of build_order so future townkit builds bake connected thresholds.
- Bump external/Blockside submodule (63_townrise.js runtime connectivity +
  90_main.js townRise floatCheck) and rebuild battle.html (5.61 MB, core
  cd35e6b10a4ab2ae).

👥 參與者：@ridge-001
